title: Epics, releases, issue planning and Kanban reports
summary: Current planning groups work into epics/releases and reports actual Kanban completion history. Planning items are not issue hierarchy nodes or Scrum sprints; this catalog does not count roadmap or time-log capabilities as implemented.

cases.title: Read project planning
preconditions: Signed in with project read access.
steps: Open the project Planning page.
expected: Epics and releases show status, description, target date and linked-issue progress.

cases.title: Read empty project planning
preconditions: Signed in with project read access.
steps: Open planning with no items.
expected: An empty state explains creating epics/releases and assigning issues.

cases.title: Page through planning items
preconditions: Signed in with project read access.
steps: Choose Load more planning items.
expected: The next cursor page appends.
notes: Surface correction preserves this complete browser behavior; stateless service outcomes are recorded separately in UC-PLN-0080.

steps: Create or edit an epic/release with Arabic name and description.

cases.title: Bound report issue payload
preconditions: Signed in with project read access.
steps: Read a report for a large project.
expected: Aging work is cursor-paged instead of sending all project issues.

cases.title: Isolate late planning-item saves
preconditions: Signed in with write access to an active project.
steps: Accept a planning-item save but delay its reply, then open another project editor.
expected: The accepted item belongs to its original project; its late reply cannot close, overwrite, reload or unlock another project editor.
notes: Reproduced destination-editor closure; saves now retain project, session, editor-generation and component ownership.
Implementation status is separate from the first-attempt runtime evidence ledger.

cases.title: Confirm discarding a dirty planning editor
preconditions: Signed in with write access to an active project.
steps: Edit an epic or release and attempt to leave; reject the confirmation, then explicitly accept leaving.
expected: Rejecting the discard keeps the route and draft intact; accepting leaves without creating a planning item. Reloading or closing a dirty editor also requests the browser leave warning.
notes: Reproduced silent dirty navigation. Planning now participates in a component-specific route discard guard and browser unload warning.
Implementation status is separate from the first-attempt runtime evidence ledger.

cases.title: Show exact current stage names in planning and reports
preconditions: Signed in with project read access.
steps: Read planning-linked and aging-report rows for work at a custom named stage.
expected: Both rows display the exact current stage name, including Arabic, while the API retains its existing status field for compatibility.
notes: Reproduced Review instead of the custom name. Bounded SQL page projections now return additive stageName without per-issue requests.
Implementation status is separate from the first-attempt runtime evidence ledger.

cases.title: Enforce viewer planning service permission
preconditions: Signed in with project read access.
steps: Read planning as a viewer and submit a planning-item or assignment write.
expected: Authorized planning reads succeed and current write permission refuses the mutation.
notes: Atomic service outcome separated from native UI case UC-PLN-0064.

cases.title: Reject stale issue-planning revision
preconditions: Signed in with write access to an active project.
steps: Submit planning assignments using a revision superseded by another accepted assignment.
expected: A typed conflict returns current null with reload_current_state; an explicit fresh assignment read retains the accepted relationships and planning revision.
notes: Atomic service outcome separated from native UI case UC-PLN-0067.
SetIssue returns stale(nil); the client fetches get_issue_planning after the conflict instead of receiving an embedded IssuePlanningView.
